title: ESMUC Choir Dataset
task: multitrack choral singing; full takes; isolated sections; short excerpts; warm-up exercises
manual_scope: F0 contours are explicitly described as manually corrected; note annotations are supplied for each non-warm-up singer track
decision_reason: Primary recordings of 12 singers with publicly downloadable audio and exhaustively human-corrected pitch trajectories; qualifies as a specialized singing-production source.
evidence_summary: Zenodo states that all close-microphone singer tracks are primary recordings from ESMUC students and that the release comprises the audio plus manually corrected F0 contours and note annotations. The associated Frontiers article likewise describes ECD as primary multitrack recordings with manually corrected F0 and note annotations.

title: Choral Singing Dataset
task: a cappella choral performance with individual close microphones
token_or_recording_size: 3 pieces; 48 principal individual singer-piece tracks; 1.1 GB archive
annotation_target: frame-wise F0 trajectories; note annotations; synchronized MIDI
manual_scope: author documentation describes the F0 annotations as automatically extracted and manually corrected
decision_reason: Primary choir recordings with an openly downloadable archive and human-corrected F0 trajectories tied to individual singers.
evidence_summary: Zenodo documents newly recorded performances by 16 Anton Bruckner Choir singers with individual audio, frame-wise F0 and note annotations; the first author's research documentation explicitly states that the F0 annotations were automatically extracted and manually corrected.
